name: Sarydil

abilities.name: Strike
abilities.description: A basic melee attack dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Teleport Strike
abilities.description: Sarydil teleports to your location and strikes you with her daggers, dealing high physical damage.

abilities.name: Fanning Strike
abilities.description: Sarydil puts her daggers in front of herself, before fanning them out at you, dealing very high physical damage and knocking you down. This attack can be blocked.

abilities.name: Dash
abilities.description: Sarydil begins to glow with pink mist, before she dashes away from you in the arena, throwing magical daggers on her way there, leaving lingering pools of magic where they land, indicated by a large amount of lingering circular AoEs, dealing continuous high magical damage. This attack is always followed by Dagger Throw.

abilities.name: Dagger Throw
abilities.description: Sarydil empties her arsenal daggers at you throwing a large amount back to back, dealing high physical damage each. This attack can be interrupted.

abilities.name: Magic Dagger Throw
abilities.description: An alternate version of the above ability. Instead of throwing the daggers directly at you, she throws them near your location, creating similar lingering magical fields as in the Dash ability.

abilities.name: Fire Bomb
abilities.description: Sarydil lobs a fire bomb at you. The explosion is indicated by a large circular AoE and deals very high flame damage. After the explosion, four smaller circular AoEs appear, marking lingering fire fields around the blast radius, dealing continuous high flame damage.

abilities.name: Aerial Fire Bomb
abilities.description: An alternate version of the above ability. Instead of throwing the fire bomb directly at you, Sarydil jumps into the air and spins around as she throws several smaller fire bombs all over the arena, creating similar lingering fire fields as in the regular Fire Bomb ability. This attack is always followed by Flame Wave.

abilities.name: Flame Wave
abilities.description: Sarydil winds up her dagger before planting it into the ground, causing a massive wave of fire to erupt from it, indicated by a quickly growing very large circular AoE, dealing very high flame damage.

abilities.name: Roll Dodge
abilities.description: Sarydil can perform a dodge to avoid a singular attack.

abilities.name: Retreat
abilities.description: At 75% and 45% health, Sarydil retreats to the upper level of the arena and calls in Ascendant reinforcements to come down and fight you in her stead. During this time, she will continue to use the Magic Dagger Throw ability while she is up above. The second wave at 45% is led by an Ascendant Bulwark.

abilities.name: Shadow Leap
abilities.description: After the reinforcements are defeated, Sarydil returns to the arena, in the form of a leap preceded by shadow pools appearing all over the arena before exploding, indicated by growing and overlapping circular AoEs, dealing high magical damage each.

abilities.name: Clone Split
abilities.description: A new ability gained after the 75% threshold. Sarydil splits into around a dozen clones spaced out all along the edge of the arena, who then proceed to use the Dagger Throw ability all at the same time against you. While they are all displayed with the same amount of health and same rank as the boss, the clones will die in one hit. Any remaining clones are dispelled if the real Sarydil is hit.

dialogue.speaker: Sarydil
dialogue.line: Again. Who hired you to deliver this?
dialogue.trigger: When you arrive at the Coral Aerie, Captain Kaleen will ask you to help her retrieve a Breton called Jakarn and the documents he was carrying when he was abducted. Within the Aldmeri Ruins you will find Jakarn being interrogated by Sarydil and Varallion.

dialogue.speaker: Jakarn
dialogue.line: You know, I can't recall. Must have been those knocks to the head.
dialogue.trigger: When you arrive at the Coral Aerie, Captain Kaleen will ask you to help her retrieve a Breton called Jakarn and the documents he was carrying when he was abducted. Within the Aldmeri Ruins you will find Jakarn being interrogated by Sarydil and Varallion.

dialogue.speaker: Sarydil
dialogue.line: Perhaps a few more will jog your memory?
dialogue.trigger: When you arrive at the Coral Aerie, Captain Kaleen will ask you to help her retrieve a Breton called Jakarn and the documents he was carrying when he was abducted. Within the Aldmeri Ruins you will find Jakarn being interrogated by Sarydil and Varallion.

dialogue.speaker: Varallion
dialogue.line: The longer you stall, Jakarn, the more likely I take what I have and leave you chained up for the yaghra. Think on that.
dialogue.trigger: When you arrive at the Coral Aerie, Captain Kaleen will ask you to help her retrieve a Breton called Jakarn and the documents he was carrying when he was abducted. Within the Aldmeri Ruins you will find Jakarn being interrogated by Sarydil and Varallion.

dialogue.line: <Sarydil and Varallion leave.>

dialogue.speaker: Sarydil
dialogue.line: Well, well. Look what washed into our yaghra trap. You can surrender, or you can become bait. Choose.

dialogue.line: You should have stayed out of Altmeri lands. You don't belong here.

related_quests: An Order Gone Awry: A secretive society named the Ascendant Order has set up operations on Coral Aerie.
summary: Sarydil is a High Elf member of the Ascendant Order. She is second in command for the group that can be found in the Coral Aerie. She serves as the second boss of the dungeon.
